environment: Codex in-app browser; authenticated consumer websites
scope: Five explicitly authorized synthetic generations, live response observation and subsequent history reload. No extension installation or product code changes.
prompt_a: Timing verification test A. Do not use tools, web search, files, or connected apps. Begin with LATENCY_CHECK_A. Then write one plain paragraph of approximately 120 words explaining how a seed grows into a tree. End with LATENCY_DONE_A.
prompt_b: Timing verification test B. Do not use tools, web search, files, or connected apps. Begin with LATENCY_CHECK_B. Then write one plain paragraph of approximately 120 words explaining how rain reaches a river. End with LATENCY_DONE_B.
privacy: Only synthetic prompt text and curated timing, schema and outcome metadata are retained. Raw authenticated requests/responses, credentials, provider conversation/message IDs, headers, tool definitions and unrelated history are excluded.
